title: Source-list owner release

scope.rationale: The existing complete SrcList destructor is canonically source-identified across SELECT, trigger, and foreign-key cleanup paths.

external_source_responsibilities: SELECT, expression-list, table, IdList, and expression destructors
dependencies.caller_closure: All typed SrcList owners use this destructor.

outputs: Every owned SrcItem child and list allocation released
contracts.ownership: Consumes names, aliases, subqueries/database names, INDEXED BY/function arguments, table references, USING/ON owners, then list.
contracts.state_and_results: Flag invariants select mutually exclusive union owners.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No I/O; caller owns schema synchronization.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Destructor allocates nothing and null is a no-op.

representation_differences: Typed flag accessors and slices replace C flexible-array iteration.

oracle.protocol: Destroy source items spanning ordinary, subquery, fixed-schema, indexed-by, table-function, USING, and ON variants.
oracle.normalization: Compare allocator ownership and child destructor observations.

assurance.performance: Linear in source count and owned child sizes.

integration.bounded_owner_retired: Existing complete implementation promoted to canonical source identity.

known_blockers: Focused variant allocator trace and independent review.

implementation_spans: all typed cleanup callers and child destructors
assertions_branches_cleanup: all source flag invariants and union-owner branches
upstream_tests: Project parser, schema, trigger, and broad runtime tests
